text:
mike.finance: Heads up, HelioCardio flagged INV-2026-1604 — they say platform fee appears twice and the totals don't match the signed renewal. Can someone pull metering?
sarit.revops: I'll pull the export. Any recent changes on their side?
jules.am: They did a private deployment migration two weeks ago but this looks different — customer mentioned a third-party integration (vendor X) that ships a metering agent. Procurement says vendor sent us a separate usage file this month.
leo.billing: Metering export uploaded: /billing/exports/2026-06/heliocardio_20260607.csv by billing-scheduler at 2026-06-07T07:12Z. Also vendor file received at /vendor/ingest/vendorx/heliocardio_20260606.json.
vendor-metering-bot: [system] Vendor ingest: vendorx file parsed; found 2,048 events. Uploaded at 2026-06-06T22:10Z.
leo.billing: Quick diff shows platform_fee line billed from standard commit and a second platform_fee coming from vendorX agent mapping. The vendor file contains duplicate heartbeat events from 2026-05-30 that map to platform_fee by our billing-mapper fallback.
sarit.revops: Root cause may be vendor agent retrying uploads after a 502 — duplicate event ids. We recently changed the mapper to prefer vendor mappings; that may have allowed platform_fee to be emitted twice instead of deduping against our primary metering. I'll open ENG-4750.
engineering-bot: [system] ENG-4750 created by sarit.revops: "billing-mapper: dedupe vendor metering events and avoid double-emitting platform_fee when primary meter exists" link: https://eng.redwood/ENG-4750
jules.am: Customer expectation: they were promised no double-billing and a 10-day complimentary validation during migration. Procurement is holding payment. We need corrected invoice + credit memo and a short vendor escalation.
mike.finance: Leo, compute credits and draft memo. Sarit, loop in vendor support to request event dedupe and confirmation. Also escalate to vendor sales ops.
leo.billing: Platform fee annual $14,400 -> daily $39.4521. Duplicate vendor-emitted days 9 days (2026-05-30 -> 2026-06-07) -> $355.07. Complimentary validation 10 days -> $394.52. Total credit $749.59. Draft CREDIT-2026-0721 and INV-2026-1604A ready.
support-vendor-bot: [system] VendorX support ticket VX-998 opened by sarit.revops: "Duplicate heartbeat events sent during 2026-05-30 outage; please confirm retry logic and provide dedupe keys". Vendor owner assigned: kate@vendorx.
sarit.revops: Vendor replied — they acknowledged retries due to a CDN outage and will publish a dedupe keys export. They also said their integration docs didn't include a dedupe guideline; will add it.
jules.am: Customer confirmed complimentary days via SE email. Forwarding to billing. Procurement says they'll release payment once portal reflects credit.
mike.finance: Approve credit memo. Leo, apply credit and push corrected invoice. Sarit, once vendor provides dedupe keys update billing-mapper and run a retroactive dedupe for the affected window; add unit tests.
leo.billing: Credit applied and INV-2026-1604A pushed to portal at 2026-06-08T16:20Z. CREDIT-2026-0721 uploaded.
sarit.revops: Vendor provided dedupe keys; patch merged to billing-mapper and canary will run 24h. ENG-4750 in review.
jules.am: Customer replied: "Thanks — portal updated and payment released." :thumbsup:
mike.finance: Marked resolved. Will include vendor dedupe guidance in next week's finance playbook. Closing thread.
